steps.action: Confirm the selected com.chirality.app bundle, service com.chirality.app.v4.capture-seal, account installation-keyring and own-App group derived from an independently authenticated profile AppIdentifierPrefix; reuse the already identified Developer ID signer without asking for its private key.
requires: Apple-issued Developer ID distribution profile and verified decode/provenance
matching public signer certificate and fingerprint
retain: original CMS and decoded plist digests
exact unsigned proposed entitlement plist digest
steps.on_failure: Retain missing or contradictory inputs; do not invent a prefix, switch group, activate None or sign.

steps.action: Review the exact compiled keychain selection and the source-wired native-menu enrollment invocation with its original-window/key_setup/Quit guards. The menu remains absent under None; admit the exact signing-stage policy before any actual invocation. Rotation witnessing still needs its separately reviewed invocation.
requires: explicit scope for actual signing and fresh-namespace SecItem witness
reviewed native host invocation; no general renderer/MCP/runtime-config authority
steps.on_failure: Stop at preparation; do not call private functions through an unreviewed entry point or silently enable startup enrollment.

steps.action: Use the packaging owner recipe to build the exact release source and sign under separately authorized signing. Retain publisher original binding/public projection/requirement independently. Verify the signed entitlements and embedded profile match this preparation, then run the installed-integrity prerequisite.
steps.on_failure: Refuse enrolled use; never treat unsigned entitlement files, profile metadata or old v3 facts as signed permission.

steps.action: Before enrollment, with the admitted namespace and marker absent, make one person-confirmed act capture: it must be recorded with its 'capture not sealed' limit, with no file-key directory, keychain add or marker created. Then, on the admitted fresh namespace, explicitly invoke initial enrollment once in the actual signed App, then seal and verify one invented capture. Restart the same signed subject and verify the same capture without another add. Throughout, observe that no keychain authorization prompt appears.
retain: nonsecret reservation/commit marker before and after
key IDs only, never key bytes
actual no-UI observations and operation result categories
capture exact bytes/seal and subsequent verification
pre-enrollment unsealed capture with its limit and absent file-key directory/marker
no-prompt observation method (operator form or screen recording) for pre-enrollment read, enrollment add/readback and restart verify
steps.on_failure: No automatic retry-add. If no marker was reserved, explicit enrollment may retry after absence checks. If reserved-only and item missing, retain the reservation and block first sealing. Any keychain prompt is a failure of the no-UI policy: repair source and produce a new candidate; never accept a prompted grant.

steps.action: Observe locked/denied/missing behavior only in an independently authorized disposable test namespace/session. Exercise a pre-enrollment denial, then clear the condition and explicitly retry; verify no file-key fallback. Do not alter the owner's ordinary login keychain.
requires: specific permission for the isolated failure controls
retain: unchanged historical files and marker facts
later successful explicit retry where unreserved
steps.on_failure: Do not reinterpret prompts, blocked callbacks, timeouts or missing items as success. Unsupported no-UI policy requires source repair and another exact candidate.

native_vs_mock.mock_covered: Missing, -25308, -25293, -34018 and malformed/foreign-group results refuse without file-key fallback; transient initial denial does not poison later enrollment; native status mapping fixtures. Mocks never call SecItem.
native_vs_mock.missing_native: Pre-enrollment missing is observed inside SC-3. Post-enrollment item loss needs deletion of the one test-user item: proposal only, separately authorized.
native_vs_mock.locked_native: Proposal only: requires an App path that reads keys without a person act while the test user's session is locked; whether a locked session makes WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly items unavailable on macOS is not established. If no such path exists, locked stays mock-only with a recorded residual.
native_vs_mock.denied_native: Not stageable on the same candidate: denial needs a differently entitled signed build, which is a different subject. Stays mock and status-mapping only unless a distinct subject is separately authorized.

steps.action: With admitted rotation invocation, retain an old committed capture, rotate once, and verify both old and new captures after restart. Separately exercise pending rotation failure in a disposable namespace: old verification and new sealing use committed keys while pending stays unchanged.
retain: old/new key IDs and marker states
cache invalidation and concurrent Verify/Seal outcomes
steps.on_failure: No overwrite/delete/reset. Missing historical key affects that historical verification; missing current key refuses new sealing; pending-only first enrollment stays unavailable.
steps.invocation_status: Blocked: no supported invocation exists. capture_seal::rotate() has only test callers, and AAC section 6.3 says rotation is a host function not offered in the interface. A signed-subject witness needs an owner-chosen clause change or host policy first; no IPC/CLI/debug entry or test relabelling substitutes.

steps.action: Join the actual signing/enrollment evidence to the existing package/S4 receiver and App candidate, preserving distinct original/private and public derivative digests. Return for owner acceptance and publication decisions.
requires: existing package receiver's independent publisher trust input
steps.on_failure: A source fixture, metadata-consistency result or signature alone never supplies native qualification, personal-act proof or release authority.

recovery.locked_or_denied_without_reservation: Clear only the authorized failure condition, then explicitly retry enrollment after fresh namespace checks.
recovery.pending_with_matching_actual_item: Explicit enrollment/rotation can commit after exact readback and retained-key checks; Verify and ordinary Seal never commit pending.
recovery.pending_only_item_missing: Preserve the reservation and failed subject. Exact secret is unrecoverable from its digest. Parent/owner must disposition continuity, for example admit a distinct new namespace in reviewed source; never delete/reset or add different bytes under the old reservation.
recovery.pending_rotation_item_missing: Continue ordinary sealing with the committed current key and historical verification with requested committed keys. Keep pending intact; explicit future recovery/disposition must preserve prior evidence.
recovery.all_marker_and_items_lost: Normal capture/verify/rotate must remain unavailable and never reenroll. Any genuinely fresh namespace needs a separately admitted explicit enrollment act.
